🏉 LEAGUE '27
The Next Generation of Roblox Rugby League.

Step onto the field in LEAGUE '27, a competitive rugby league experience built for players who want more than just another football game.

Experience fast-paced 7v7 matches, powerful tackles, precision kicking, realistic rugby league rules and intense last-minute finishes.

🏆 GAME FEATURES
- Competitive 7v7 Rugby League
- Advanced Tackling, Sidesteps & Fends
- Precision Passing & Kicking
- Bunker Reviews & Realistic Match Rules
- Customise and Upgrade Your MyPLAYER
- Earn League Coins & Unlock Rewards
- Season 1 Pass & Player Progression
- League Mode for Competitive Matches

🚀 MORE TO COME
We're constantly improving gameplay, animations, presentation and competitive features.

⚠️ EARLY ACCESS
LEAGUE '27 is still in active development. You may encounter bugs or unfinished features as we continue updating the game.

Join the community, bring your mates and make your mark on the field.

🏉 LEAGUE '27 - YOUR GAME. YOUR LEGACY.
